# WM A11y Sensory Governor

> WordPress plugin: prints WCAG 2.2 focus-ring (SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured) and reduced-motion (SC 2.3.3) CSS into the site head, exposes WP 6.5+ Block Bindings (`wm-sensory/tokens`) and a GenerateBlocks 2.x dynamic tag (`{{wm_sensory_token}}`), and calculates colour-contrast ratios in the admin, over rate-limited REST (`wm-sensory/v1/calculate-contrast`) and on WP-CLI (`wp a11y contrast`).

## Overview

`wm-a11y-sensory-governor` is a WordPress plugin developed with an agentic workflow (AI coding agents). It stores four options (focus governor on/off, motion governor on/off, focus-ring colour, opt-in uninstall data deletion), ships no frontend JavaScript, no shortcode and no custom database table, makes no external request, and registers as a spoke of the WM Suite Hub when the hub is active.

## Standards & Compliance

- Version 1.2.2.
- PHP 8.2+ / strict types / WordPress coding style
- Zero-CDN Invariant (self-hosted assets in `/assets/`)
- Nonce & Capability Verification / Transient HMAC-SHA256 REST Rate-Limiting / Late Escaping
- CSS aimed at WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 and 2.3.3, contrast ratios per SC 1.4.3 / 1.4.11; no conformance assessment · no raw IP or personal data stored
